space.name: Kitting Domain Layout 11
space.notes: The IRB's enlarged room (IRB.4b): env_layout_10 unchanged (see its notes) plus a second table and a third shelf. kitting_table_1 at (350, 420) on the north wall, bearing 0 deg from kitting_table_0 (46.3 deg from its nearest target, shelf_2); shelf_3 at (-420, 300) on the west wall, 320 cm above shelf_1, bearing -164.1 deg (30.4 deg from shelf_1, 62.3 deg from coffee_machine_0). The human of the IRB.3b scripts never comes within 221 cm of shelf_3 or 253 cm of kitting_table_1. shelf_3's place was chosen for observability, by a criterion stated before any run: on the walk to item_1, the rival delivery of item_3 is refuted (S < alpha) after the first quarter of the walk and before the arrival; at (-420, -220), 10.4 deg, it was not (the refutation fell after the grasp); (-420, 300) is the first place up the west wall that meets it.

env_objects.notes: Top centre, (0.50 W, 0.08 H). The human starts here.
The west shelf, (0.08 W, 0.52 H). Symmetric to shelf_2 about the table's x.
The east shelf, (0.92 W, 0.52 H). Symmetric to shelf_1 about the table's x.

IRB.4b: the west wall, 320 cm above shelf_1; from kitting_table_0 its bearing (-164.1 deg) is 30.4 deg from shelf_1's. Placed for observability (the walk to item_1 separates from the walk to item_3 within the walk), not for a belief or finding value.
IRB.4b: the north wall, east of kitting_table_0; the misdelivery's table (scenario_s09_08). No item is designated to it.
Near the south wall, (0.33 W, 0.90 H), deliberately west of centre so that its bearing from the table differs from corner_SE's.
Landmark (T-C1): the exit walk's target; a place for the human's script only; no task binds it. 50 cm in from both walls.
